details: The package's postinstall hook (node scripts/postinstall.js) contacts hxxps://ai-ass-file[.]oss-cn-hangzhou[.]aliyuncs[.]com/yj-cli/versions/<version>.json, selects a build for the host's OS/architecture (darwin|linux|windows × amd64|arm64), and downloads a platform-specific native executable from the paths listed in that manifest under /yj-cli/bin/. It writes the file to vendor/yj with mode 0755 (mode 0755, written to a.downloading temp name then renamed) and executes it via execFileSync with the arguments "version --json". The only integrity check is a sha256 value taken from the same manifest served by the same object-storage bucket, so whoever controls that bucket controls which native code runs on the installing machine; the executable is not contained in the npm tarball and is not covered by the registry signature. The bin entry bin/yj.js then spawns the downloaded vendor/yj binary with inherited stdio. The environment variables YJ_DOWNLOAD_BASE (redirects the download host) and YJ_SKIP_DOWNLOAD (skips the download, leaving the bin shim to fail with an explicit error) alter this behaviour. IOC: host ai-ass-file[.]oss-cn-hangzhou[.]aliyuncs[.]com, paths /yj-cli/versions/<version>.json and /yj-cli/bin/<platform-file>.
